description: Combines up to seven gate or trigger signals onto one of two busses, each bus being a seven-input OR gate

params.text: Sends that row's input to bus A, to bus B, or to neither in its middle position

inputs.text: The gate or trigger for that row, counted as high above 2V and sent to whichever bus that row's switch picks

outputs.text: Goes to 10V while any row switched to A has a high signal, and 0V otherwise
Goes to 10V while any row switched to B has a high signal, and 0V otherwise

notes: every row switch starts in its middle position, feeding neither bus, so nothing reaches A or B until a switch is moved

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
